entities.title: Skilled Immigration to Germany
entities.summary: Germany offers skilled workers from non-EU states various opportunities to come and take up employment, particularly in IT, care, and skilled craft sectors, under the Skilled Immigration Act. The visa application process has been simplified, including online applications.
application_process: Apply online for a German visa on the Consular Services Portal
Get professional qualifications recognised in Germany before applying for a visa
important_notes: Skilled workers from abroad must get their professional qualifications recognised in Germany in good time before they apply for a visa
